edits.new: Record one open-ended counterexample question per direction: "Which case admitted by [the proposed child] violates [one independently required parent condition]?" Name the child and quote the single parent condition being tested. Do not ask a yes/no question about the child failing the parent's complete definition. Construct a concrete candidate that changes only that condition, then check it against the whole child meaning and every permitted parent connection. In the answer, give a valid counterexample, explain why the candidate contradicts a child requirement and establish the remaining coverage conditions, or use null if admission or exclusion remains unresolved. The question does not presume that a counterexample exists. A failed candidate alone does not prove full coverage.
edits.old: Record one concrete question per direction about its decisive attempted variation. Name the proposed child, what the information concerns, and the parent condition tested. Ask whether that information is admitted by the child and excluded by the parent. Resolve that exact question in its answer. For a positive answer, establish the remaining conditions too; excluding one variation alone does not prove full coverage.
